clues.why: A stranger knows where you are every morning

clues.evidence: Every day I catch the 7:45 bus from the same stop.
clues.why: A stranger can predict where you will be at a fixed time
Your birthday helps scammers guess passwords and answer security questions

text.stranger_summary: A stranger could learn your college, your daily schedule, and your birthday.
text.scam_message: EXAMPLE SCAM (for awareness): Hi, this is the college accounts office. Your BMSIT fee for this semester is overdue. Pay now at [link] before your 14 March birthday or your account will be blocked.
fixes: Do not post your schedule while on the way
Avoid sharing the exact time and place of your daily routine
Keep your full birth date private
Turn off location on your camera app
Remove hidden photo data before sharing files
